goal: Repair NBA PRA Page 2 live acceptance: preserve verified opponent history, fill legitimate current-preseason usage/rank before older fallback, preserve Page 1 Kyre score and availability into Page 2, and keep the professional loading overlay mounted through the actual fetch.

routing_contract.conflicting_lines: preserve sportsbook, line, price, timestamp; never average

acceptance.history_opponent: When an approved source provides an opponent, the normalized game row retains it and Page 2 can render OPP and exact prior-opponent history.
acceptance.usage_rank: Current NBA Stats regular season first, current preseason for still-missing players, prior regular season last; no cross-period averaging or estimation.
acceptance.score_parity: At the same sportsbook line, Page 2 receives the same Kyre Edge score/tier semantics Page 1 displays.
acceptance.availability_parity: A verified same-player Page 1 availability label may fill an immediately unverified Page 2 refresh; newer explicit Page 2 status wins.
acceptance.loading: The fixed professional overlay remains mounted across the actual Page 2 snapshot and matchup fetch and no 80ms flash/rerun remains.
acceptance.line_lab: Slider moves remain local with zero external fetches.
acceptance.source_guard: No SGO/SportsGameOdds or ESPN/ESPN BET in the repaired active path.
